name: Zillertaler Museumsbahn
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Zillertal steam railway has linked Jenbach and Mayrhofen since 1902 with nostalgic locomotives, open-air carriages, and a Swarovski crystal carriage.
beschreibung:
Overview

The nostalgic Zillertaler Museumsbahn – the famed heritage steam train of the Zillertal Railway – ranks among Austria's most delightful historic railway attractions. Since its inaugural journey in 1902, the 760 mm narrow-gauge line (known historically as the Bosnian gauge) has linked the Inn Valley town of Jenbach with the communities of the Zillertal up to Mayrhofen. When the mighty steam engine, now over 120 years old, sets off amidst hissing valves, rhythmic chuffing, and ringing bells, passengers are transported back into Belle Époque railway romance. Over 32 scenic kilometres, the train ambles gently through the wide alpine valley, passing lush meadows and traditional chalets framed by the towering summits of the Tux and Zillertal Alps.

Route & Requirements

The heritage journey runs from Jenbach via Fügen, Kaltenbach, and Zell am Ziller to the terminal station at Mayrhofen, taking roughly 90 leisurely minutes for the entire length. Passengers can board and alight at key stations or travel partial routes. The rolling stock is a travelling attraction in itself: alongside classic wooden-bench two-axle carriages, guests can ride in an open-top sightseeing carriage ("Cabrio"), a cosy buffet car serving refreshments, and the famous crystal carriage embellished with 62,000 sparkling Swarovski crystals. The journey is step-free and wonderfully relaxing for families, seniors, and railway fans of all ages. Bicycles can be carried free of charge in the luggage wagon, making it an ideal companion to a bike tour on the flat Zillertal cycle path.

Visit & Arrival

Steam services run during summer from early June until early October according to a seasonal timetable (generally Wednesday through Sunday with one to two train pairs daily). Tickets for single or return journeys are available at station ticket offices (adults approx. €26.00 return; discounted child tickets). Jenbach station is a major railway hub on the main ÖBB line, served directly by Railjet and EuroCity services from Innsbruck, Salzburg, and Munich. Drivers reach Jenbach via the Inntal A12 motorway (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), with parking available at the station.

Tips

In sunny weather, be sure to secure a spot in the open-air viewing carriage to enjoy the mountain breeze and the authentic aroma of coal and steam. Pair the steam train outbound trip with a gentle downhill cycle back along the scenic banks of the River Ziller.
preis: Full-line return trip adults approx. €26.00, section fares and child rates available; Zillertal Activcard discount
oeffnungszeiten: Summer season June to early October according to steam timetable (typically Wednesday to Sunday)
